name: cumulative_anthropogenic_co2_since_1850
description: Cumulative anthropogenic CO2 emissions since 1850 (GCB2025 Table 8), their partitioning into atmosphere, ocean and land, the cost of removal at 1000 USD per t in years of world GDP, and the question how climate-relevant the absorbed share remains: CO2 impulse response function (Joos 2013), zero emissions commitment (MacDougall 2020), emission/removal asymmetry (Zickfeld 2021), perturbation airborne fraction and sink weakening under negative emissions (Jones 2016), CMIP6 carbon cycle feedback parameters and TCRE (Arora 2020).

formulas.name: fossil plus land-use
formulas.expression: cumulative anthropogenic CO2 emissions = fossil CO2 emissions + land-use change CO2 emissions

formulas.name: absorbed_sum
formulas.expression: absorbed anthropogenic CO2 = ocean sink + land sink

formulas.name: tcre_gtc_to_gtco2
formulas.expression: degree Celsius per 1000 GtCO2 = degree Celsius per 1000 GtC ÷ 3.664

formulas.name: irf_fit
formulas.expression: IRF(t) = a0 + a1 × exp(−t ÷ tau1) + a2 × exp(−t ÷ tau2) + a3 × exp(−t ÷ tau3)
formulas.note: exp is not evaluated by the zukunft.com engine; values precomputed

formulas.name: rebound_from_irf
formulas.expression: rebound share = 1 − airborne fraction of pulse

formulas.name: removal_effectiveness
formulas.expression: removal effectiveness = airborne fraction of pulse × (1 − emission removal asymmetry CO2 ÷ 100)

formulas.name: effective_stock
formulas.expression: effective climate-relevant CO2 stock = atmospheric CO2 increase + absorbed anthropogenic CO2 × rebound share

formulas.name: perturbation_airborne_fraction
formulas.expression: perturbation airborne fraction = atmospheric CO2 reduction ÷ negative emissions applied
